OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Required model-provider API key. Provider charges are separate from Railway.

OPENAI_API_BASE.description: Openai api base for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

LLM_MODEL_NAME.description: Llm model name for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME.description: Embedding model name for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

EMBEDDING_MODEL_API_URL.description: Embedding model api url for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DBGPT_LANG.description: Dbgpt lang for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generated Formbricks encryption key. Back it up securely; changing it can make encrypted data unreadable.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Public url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

DBGPT_MAX_PARALLEL_SUBAGENTS.description: Dbgpt max parallel subagents for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

HF_HOME.description: Hf home for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for db-gpt. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for db-gpt. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
